title: DOE holds the nation's most important secrets

tellings.quote: I learned some of this nation's most important secrets [music] at DOE, not CIA. DOE does stuff that man

plain: Some of America's most important secrets are kept at the Department of Energy, the US government department, not at the CIA, the US spy agency, says Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA chief. He says he learned these secrets himself while working at the Department of Energy around 2005 to 2008, and that the department "does stuff" beyond what people expect, which would mean the deepest secrets sit somewhere few people look.
